abstract: Childhood orbital teratomas are usually congenital lesions that are most often present at birth with progressive, massive unilateral proptosis. During the routine controls of 27-year-old woman between 26-27(th) weeks of pregnancy her fetal ultrasonography (USG) revealed a mass in the eye of the fetus, and termination was recommended. The family refused the termination option and in the 37(th) week of pregnancy, vaginal delivery is performed in an external medical center. The mass in the baby's eye was surgically removed. Microscopic examination revealed disorganized ocular tissues, adipose tissue, microcalcification, nerve plexuses as well as areas of neuronal nodules including hypercellular areas, palisatic necrosis, and microvascular proliferation. The immunprofile--patchy GFAP staining in the areas of cellular epithelioid and spindled cells that also show an focal and sparse expression p53 staining and a high proliferation rate in Ki67 staining--confirmed the hematoxylin-eosin (HE) impression of a teratoma with a component of glioblastoma (GBM). In this unique presentation of a malignant orbital teratoma with a GBM, we have identified three tumor components: (1) GBM component, (2) nodules of neuroglial tissue with mature neurons and BRAF mutation, and (3) papillary proliferation possibly representing a choroid plexus papilloma.
abstract_ja: 小児の眼窩奇形腫は通常先天性病変であり、多くは出生時に、進行性で大量の片側性眼球突出を伴って存在する。27歳の女性の定期検診中、妊娠26～27週の間に胎児の超音波検査(USG)で眼に腫瘤が認められ、妊娠中絶が勧められた。家族は中絶を拒否し、妊娠37週に外部の医療機関で経膣分娩が行われた。乳児の眼の腫瘤は外科的に摘出された。顕微鏡検査では、組織が乱れた眼組織、脂肪組織、微小石灰化、神経叢、および、高細胞密度領域、柵状壊死、微小血管増殖を含む神経細胞結節領域が認められた。免疫プロファイルでは、類上皮様細胞および紡錘形細胞の領域においてGFAPがまだら状に染色され、p53は限局性かつ疎らに発現し、Ki67では高い増殖率が認められた。これにより、膠芽腫(GBM)成分を伴う奇形腫というヘmatoxylin-eosin(HE)所見の印象が確認された。GBMを伴う悪性眼窩奇形腫という特異な症例において、我々は3つの腫瘍成分を同定した：(1)GBM成分、(2)BRAF変異を伴う成熟神経細胞を含む神経グリア組織結節、(3)脈絡叢乳頭腫を表すと考えられる乳頭状増殖。
